example.title: The adventure of Mimi and Cookie
example.prompt: Mimi and Cookie go on a mountain hike, along the way they discover a secret cave with sparkling crystals. Cookie picks up a mysterious trail that leads them to a hidden lake. There they hear a voice that gives them a mission: find a magic flower at the top. Together they overcome obstacles and find the flower that lights up the whole valley.

characters.mimi: Girl, 13 years old, fair skin, black hair, green eyes, she has long hair
characters.anton: Dog, young, white coat, a white Jack Russell with brown patches

pages.cover: Join Mimi and Cookie on a magical adventure! Hike, discover secrets and find the flower that will light up the valley!
pages.page1: On a sunny morning, Cookie and Mimi get ready for their mountain hike, eager to discover new horizons.
pages.page2: « I can feel this day is going to be incredible! » exclaims Cookie. He smiles with enthusiasm.
pages.page3: They start climbing the mountain, admiring the magnificent landscape all around them, each step bringing them closer to their goal.
pages.page4: « Look at that cave! » cries Mimi, pointing to a mysterious opening in the rock. Cookie nods with curiosity.
pages.page5: Entering the cave, they discover sparkling crystals that glitter like stars on the dark ceiling.
pages.page6: « It shines so much! » whispers Cookie in amazement. Mimi nods with a big smile.
pages.page7: Suddenly, Cookie picks up a mysterious trail leading to a hidden lake behind the trees. « Follow me! » he says with determination.
pages.page8: « Look at this lake! » exclaims Mimi in wonder. Their eyes shine at the beauty of the landscape.
pages.page9: « Hello young adventurers! » says the wise voice near the lake.
pages.page10: « You must find a magic flower at the top of the mountain » explains the voice wisely. The two friends nod seriously.
pages.page11: « Together we can accomplish this mission! » says Cookie with determination. Mimi smiles and takes his hand.
pages.page12: « We found the magic flower! » cries Mimi joyfully, holding the shining flower. Cookie smiles proudly beside her.
